description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training examples and the overall ROUGE-G score for several multi-document summarization models, including PELMS, Pegasus-X, Primera, and Centrum, with some variants trained on only 5% of the data. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” is linear and spans from 0 to 64, with tick marks at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score,” is linear and ranges from 11.0 to 19.0, with major tick intervals of 2.0 (11.0, 13.0, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0). The solid green line with circle markers (PELMS) starts at approximately 16.8 at 0 examples, rises to 18.8 at 16 examples, and plateaus near 18.9 at 64 examples. The dashed green line with circle markers (Pegasus-X (5%)) begins at ~16.8, rises to ~17.2 at 16, and reaches ~17.8 at 64. The solid red line with square markers (Primera) starts at ~15.0, increases to ~17.0 at 16, and ends at ~18.2 at 64. The dashed red line with square markers (Primera (5%)) begins at ~15.0, dips slightly to ~14.7 at 16, and recovers to ~15.8 at 64. The solid blue line with triangle markers (Pegasus-X) starts at ~13.5, drops to ~11.5 at 16, then rises to ~14.2 at 64. The dashed blue line with triangle markers (Centrum (5%)) begins at ~13.5, dips to ~11.5 at 16, and rises to ~14.2 at 64. The solid yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum) starts at ~15.8, remains relatively flat at ~15.8 at 16, and ends at ~16.5 at 64. The dashed yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum (5%)) begins at ~15.8, stays flat at ~15.8 at 16, and ends at ~16.0 at 64.
